This is the textbook appearance of **Stripe Rust** (Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici). The defining feature is the stripe arrangement of uredinia running parallel to leaf veins — no other wheat disease produces this precise pattern. Wheat Leaf Rust produces scattered circular pustules, and Stem Rust affects stems with larger brick-red pustules. The linear striping here is unmistakable.
